record_title: Auxiliary-energy shifts control IEQ/SAV Allen–Cahn monotonicity reversals
provenance: Algebraic analysis of the spatially homogeneous IEQ and SAV Allen–Cahn recurrences in arXiv:2609.19023v1, including exact auxiliary-shift normalization, threshold differentiation, and deterministic recurrence verification.
limitations: The exact IEQ/SAV conjugacy is restricted to spatially homogeneous states, and the sign classification concerns the first two steps from consistent initialization. No universal optimal auxiliary shift, long-time convergence theorem, or uniform nonhomogeneous perturbation radius is claimed.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic evaluation of the homogeneous IEQ/SAV conjugacy, exact first-step formula, shift threshold, and critical-shift sign switch.
Recorded deterministic output for the recurrence and threshold checks.
